educationalGoal: In teaching practice It is important to apply basic knowledge and skill learned in the university, understand the students in the training school, build the ideal image of a teacher.
advice:
【Before the teaching practice】
Orientation is held at the training school, and the supervisor gives explanations and instructions on the subject and the division of school duties. At that time, it is also important to confirm the current situation of the training school.
【During the teaching practice】
●The first week
 Observation school duties and students
●The second and third week
 Conduct student guidance, career guidance, and extracurricular activities.
●The last week
 Reflection and summery of teaching practice

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Make a creative lesson plan which allows students to participate in classes.

(2) Conduct a lesson in which students independently learn according to the learning teaching plan.

(3) Reflect on the lessons, point out problems, and make a concrete improvements.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Make a lesson plan in the school.

(2) Conduct a lesson according to the learning teaching plan.

(3) Reflect on the lesson and point put problems.

Orientation is held at the training school, and the supervisor gives explanations and instructions on the subject and the division of school duties. At that time, it is also important to confirm the current situation of the training school.

 Observation school duties and students
